name: GLab
description: Guang’s personal profile and public knowledge hub for complete projects with embedded guides, technical articles, research notes and documented experiments across technology, cybersecurity, AI, networking, sustainability and engineering.

intro: Passionate about building a future where technology and nature coexist harmoniously. I enjoy exploring cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, sustainable farming, networking and hands-on engineering projects.
I believe in using technology thoughtfully to create positive change for people, communities and the planet.
profile.statement: Technology should do more than innovate. It should improve lives, strengthen communities, and help build a sustainable future.
profile.workLine: Deep dives into things I’ve designed, tested, broken, documented, and learned from.
profile.background: My background combines hands-on broadband and network operations with self-directed software, Linux, cybersecurity, automation and community-focused technology projects.
